overnightRisk: Next report is about 02:00 COT. The heatmap shows a dense long-liquidation stack at 80.0-80.4k and a bright band at 79.2k, only 1.0-2.5% below spot, which can pull price down fast in thin Asia hours. A flush through 79,838 likely tags 79.2k before bouncing, so the 79,500 resting stop matters. Upside: the 81.7k and 82.0k bands are the squeeze targets if 81,298 flips to support. No US ETF print or US macro event is due before the report; Asia open is the usual catalyst for gaps. Longs are only mildly crowded (CoinGlass 24h long/short 51/49).
